meta.title: IS Fleet — From chaos to control. One system for the whole fleet
meta.description: One system for the whole fleet: trips, trucks, CMRs and the whole team — dispatchers, managers and drivers — on the same page.

lang.label: Language
lang.suggest: This page is also available in English.

hero.title:
From chaos
to control
hero.sub: <lead>One system for the whole fleet.</lead> Trips, trucks, CMRs and the whole team — dispatchers, managers and drivers — on the same page.

desk.title: Web dashboard
desk.text: The dispatcher plans the trip at the desk.

manager.title: IS Manager
manager.text: The manager follows it from the phone.

driver.title: IS Driver
driver.text: The driver gets it in the cab.

compare.title: Your dispatcher shouldn't be the only system you have.

trips.old: Trips scattered across chats, spreadsheets and notebooks.
trips.new: Every trip in one system — stops, time windows, truck and driver.

cmr.old: CMR photos buried in chats — never there when accounting asks.
cmr.new: CMRs attached to the trip, found in seconds when accounting asks.

where.old: “Where’s the truck?” means another phone call.
where.new: See where every trip stands — without picking up the phone.

swap.old: Changing a driver or vehicle means re-sending everything by hand.
swap.new: Swap a truck or driver in one click — history and files follow.

head.old: Your whole operation lives in one dispatcher’s head.
head.new: Every trip is in the system, not someone’s head.

features.title: Everything a trip needs, in one place.
features.sub: Built around the trip — the unit your business actually runs on. Less chasing, fewer calls, nothing lost between apps.

trips.title: Trip Management
trips.text: Loading, unloading and waypoints with dates and time windows. Watch a trip go from planned to delivered — without chasing updates.

fleet.title: Fleet Visibility
fleet.text: See every truck, the trip it’s on and who’s driving — at a glance, without a single call. Drivers show as online, busy or resting.

docs.title: Documents per Trip
docs.text: CMRs, delivery notes and photos filed under the trip they belong to. Found in seconds by trip number, date or postcode — there when accounting asks.

swap.title: One-Click Driver/Vehicle Swap
swap.text: Move a trip to another truck or driver. Its history and documents move with it — nothing re-sent, nothing re-typed.

notify.title: Real-Time Notifications
notify.text: New trips, changes and documents reach the right phone the moment they happen — and stay quiet while a driver rests.

context.title: Communication in Context
context.text: Messages live on the trip they’re about, next to its stops and documents — so you ask less and everyone sees the same thing. Archived when the trip closes.

apps.title: At the desk, on the phone, in the cab.

desktop.label: For dispatchers
desktop.title: Web dashboard
desktop.text: Plan the trip at the desk — stops, time windows, truck and driver. In the browser or as a desktop app for Windows and macOS that updates itself.

manager.label: For managers on the move
manager.title: IS Manager
manager.text: Your trucks, trips and drivers in your pocket on iOS and Android, with a push when something changes.

driver.label: For drivers
driver.title: IS Driver
driver.text: The trip lands in the cab: addresses, documents and the trip chat. Sign in with a phone number and an SMS code.

who.title: Who it's for
who.sub: Built for road freight — any fleet size, domestic or cross-border.

size.title: Fleets of any size
size.text: From a handful of trucks to hundreds — get organized without a heavy TMS. Up and running in days.

intl.title: International hauliers
intl.text: Every trip, CMR and document in one place across borders. Nothing lost between countries.

mixed.title: Subcontractors & mixed fleets
mixed.text: Owned trucks and hired drivers on one board. Everyone sees the same trips.

lang.title: Mixed-language teams
lang.text: Built for fleets where managers and drivers don’t share a language — so addresses and instructions don’t get lost in translation.
